profile.headline: Senior Systems Software Engineer @ Nvidia | Machine Learning and Robotics
profile.summary:
Software developer specializing in embedded systems, computer vision and machine learning. 

Currently working at NVIDIA on the Tech Marketing team to help improve both software and hardware product offerings through comprehensive technical reviews.

Previously worked at Georgia Tech Research Institute as a Robotics Software Engineer, conducting research for various sponsor-based projects, and implementing new features. The platform for those projects include small unmanned aerial vehicles, autonomous aquatic surface vehicles, among other autonomous vehicles.

positions.title: System Software Engineer
positions.description: Improving both enterprise and consumer product offerings across all of NVIDIA.

positions.title: Robotics Software Developer
positions.description:
Responsible for supporting efforts on various autonomous robotic projects.
Accomplished through integrating new features into the autonomy architecture, creating auxiliary tools, and maintaining robust documentation.

positions.title: Software Development Lead
positions.description:
Responsible for leading a team of 20 developers to maintain and improve autonomy software architecture.
Some accomplishments have been the development of a new ROS2 software architecture, implementation of various forms of computer vision based obstacle avoidance, and the design of a ukf-based state estimation system.

positions.title: Robotics Intern
positions.locationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
positions.description:
Responsible for the perception implementation on an autonomous mower. 
Accomplished through the development and optimization of a "perception pipeline", a series of pointcloud filters designed to allow for real time processing of raw pointcloud data into usable end user data.

organizations.name: Georgia Tech Marine Robotics
organizations.description: Competition focused team that competes in multiple international AUV competitions a year. I'm responsible for leading the software team, where I manage the development of our autonomy architecture and integration of new features. My software design philosphy is to embrace simplicity through modular systems and open design. Most recently, I've been leading the design of a new autonomy architecture,  built on ROS2, from the ground up.
